sources.title: modnet: Image-to-Image model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview modnet is a lightweight deep learning model for portrait matting that removes backgrounds from images in real-time without requiring auxiliary inputs like trimaps. Built by pollinations, this model uses an Efficient Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling (e-ASPP) module to fuse multi-scale features and achieves 67 frames per second on a 1080Ti GPU.
